name: Multiattack
description: The creature makes two or more attacks on its turn. Note which attacks below in the creature's other actions.

name: Dagger
description: Melee or thrown weapon attack. On a hit, deals 1d4 piercing damage plus the wielder's ability modifier. Finesse, light, range 20/60.

name: Shortsword
description: Melee weapon attack. On a hit, deals 1d6 piercing damage plus the wielder's ability modifier. Finesse, light.

name: Longsword
description: Melee weapon attack. On a hit, deals 1d8 slashing damage (1d10 if used with two hands) plus the wielder's ability modifier.

name: Greataxe
description: Melee weapon attack with a heavy two-handed axe. On a hit, deals 1d12 slashing damage plus the wielder's Strength modifier.

name: Shortbow
description: Ranged weapon attack, range 80/320. On a hit, deals 1d6 piercing damage plus the wielder's Dexterity modifier.

name: Longbow
description: Ranged weapon attack, range 150/600. On a hit, deals 1d8 piercing damage plus the wielder's Dexterity modifier.

name: Bite
description: Natural melee attack. On a hit, deals 1d6 piercing damage plus the creature's Strength modifier.

name: Claw
description: Natural melee attack. On a hit, deals 1d4 slashing damage plus the creature's Strength modifier.

name: Slam
description: Natural melee attack with a heavy limb or body. On a hit, deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus the creature's Strength modifier.

name: Fire Breath
description: The creature exhales fire in a cone. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Recharges after a short rest.

name: Frightful Presence
description: Each creature of the DM's choice within 120 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Rage
description: The creature enters a rage: advantage on Strength checks and saves, bonus damage on melee attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Lasts up to 1 minute.

name: Second Wind
description: The creature regains 1d10 hit points plus its level. Usable once per short or long rest.

name: Dash
description: The creature gains extra movement equal to its speed for the current turn.

name: Disengage
description: The creature's movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Parry
description: The creature adds to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, it must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Opportunity Attack
description: When a hostile creature it can see leaves its reach, the creature makes one melee attack against that creature.

name: Legendary Resistance
description: If the creature fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. Limited uses per day.

name: Pack Tactics
description: The creature has advantage on an attack roll against a target if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the target and isn't incapacitated.

name: Keen Senses
description: The creature has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on its heightened sight, hearing, or smell.

name: Spellcasting
description: The creature is a spellcaster. Add its prepared spells in the Spells section of its sheet.
